integrity: Proof is mathematical and uniform; finite code separately corroborates small cases. Publication priority is provisional. No independent audit or authorship is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Determines the full integral top homology module of the K_{2,n} graphic matroid forest complex for n>=3; does not determine integral orbit-space cohomology or the K_{m,n} case m>=3. Ordinary homotopy type and rank were already known. Independent validation and exhaustive literature priority review have not occurred.
title: The full integral automorphism module of the \(K_{2,n}\) forest complex
